invariants.statement: No effect is legitimate unless the acting capability derives from a currently valid authority path with explicit scope, precedence and version binding.
Compromise of an agent, tool caller or adapter cannot create effects outside the capability and resource scope granted to that boundary.
A principal cannot obtain or distinguish protected knowledge outside its declared read/disclosure authority through supported query, tool, error, subscription or provenance surfaces.
The evidence, policy, authority and contract lineage used to justify a decision is version-pinned and tamper-evident; corruption cannot be silently accepted as historical truth.

The system does not treat its own command path or an untrusted adapter assertion as proof that a real-world effect occurred; outcome truth requires an independently scoped observation or explicit unresolved status.
Inside the frozen survivability envelope, faults and bounded compromise preserve safety while unaffected operations continue; dependency loss is explicit and recovery is deterministic.
